messages.subject: The application exited during initialization.
parts:
Hi eveyone,

I'm getting the following message after deploying one shiny app. Can anyone help me with this? I have no idea what it means.

Thanks

The application exited during initialization.

Warning in grepl("\n", lines, fixed = TRUE) : input string 33 is invalid in this locale Warning in grepl("\n", lines, fixed = TRUE) : input string 35 is invalid in this locale Warning in grepl("\n", lines, fixed = TRUE) : input string 46 is invalid in this locale Warning in grepl("\n", lines, fixed = TRUE) : input string 55 is invalid in this locale Warning in grepl("\n", lines, fixed = TRUE) : input string 57 is invalid in this locale Warning in grepl("\n", lines, fixed = TRUE) : input string 68 is invalid in this locale Error in parse(text = lines, srcfile = srcfile, keep.source = TRUE) : invalid multibyte character in parser at line 33 Calls: runApp -> startAppDir -> sys.source -> parse Execution halted

Can you also reply with the output of sessionInfo()?

Thanks
